# Nicolas de Chamfort

*1741 – 1794 · French*

A man of letters pampered by the court, then won over to the Revolution, he left *Maxims and Thoughts* of biting pessimism about society; threatened with arrest under the Terror, he died of the aftermath of a suicide attempt.
